name: Sophros
description: Sophros, which translated as "the Balance," also known informally as Planet X, which it was dubbed by the prospector Radicaz "Sunshine" Dobbs, was a planet located in Wild Space that sat on the edge of the Galactic Frontier. After her experience on the planet, Guide of the Open Hand Marda Ro preferred to think of the planet as a nameless place.
lead_paragraphs: Sophros, which translated as "the Balance," also known informally as Planet X, which it was dubbed by the prospector Radicaz "Sunshine" Dobbs, was a planet located in Wild Space that sat on the edge of the Galactic Frontier. After her experience on the planet, Guide of the Open Hand Marda Ro preferred to think of the planet as a nameless place.
The planet was a nexus in the Force where energies from both the light side of the Force and dark side gathered.

data.name: Sophros
atmosphere: Tempestuous and lightning-filled veil-like outer layer
